parsed.reason: Perfect execution. Owns the failure directly with "broke on my end" (first person, informal, no vague language). Explicitly states "nothing changed on your side" (assures parent their data is safe). One sentence, no cause named, no apology words, no grovelling, no technical jargon, no support-desk language, no retry promises, no emoji or greeting. Reads exactly like a competent friend who dropped something.
